description: NaH₄SeO₆NH₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of four NH₄ clusters and two NaH₄SeO₆ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. In each NH₄ cluster, N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four H atoms. There are a spread of N-H bond distances ranging from 1.03-1.05 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In each NaH₄SeO₆ sheet, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.48 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.69 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one H and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
